title: Fuel Arrangements and Fuel Prices Published by Each Rate Class
content:
Every one of the six Car Rental Rate Classes names one fuel arrangement and publishes two fuel figures: the
price a gallon is sold at where fuel is bought in advance from the supplier, and the service charge added
where the supplier has to refuel the vehicle itself.

| Rate class | Fuel arrangement | Price per gallon where fuel is bought in advance, in USD | Refuelling service charge, in USD |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Pay Now Saver Rate | full to full | 5.49 | 35 |
| Pay Now Standard Rate | full to full | 5.49 | 32 |
| Pay At Counter Flex Rate | full to full | 5.29 | 29 |
| Inclusive Flex Rate | same to same | 5.29 | 25 |
| Premium Inclusive Rate | prepaid | 4.99 | 0 |
| Corporate Negotiated Drive Rate | full to full | 4.89 | 22 |

## What the three arrangements name

A class on the full to full arrangement expects the vehicle back with a full tank. A class on the same to
same arrangement expects it back at the level it left with. A class on the prepaid arrangement sells the
tank in advance at the class's own price a gallon. Four of the six classes are full to full; one is same to
same; one is prepaid.

## Notes on the two figures

The price a gallon is published on every class, whatever its arrangement, and runs from 4.89 USD on the
Corporate Negotiated Drive Rate to 5.49 USD on the two Pay Now classes. The refuelling service charge runs
from 22 USD to 35 USD, and stands at nothing on the Premium Inclusive Rate, which is the only class selling
its tank in advance.
